theme: conjecture shot: seal legends against stratigraphic height at Mohenjo-daro, excavator split
question: Was the closing stock of Mohenjo-daro seal legends (final signs and two-sign closing formulae) fixed from the lowest excavated levels while opening signs, sign variants and legend length drifted, testing on Mackay's DK-G seals (levels against the DK datum) and confirming once on Marshall's areas (depth below the modern surface ranked within excavated sections)?
outcome: Discovery, Mackay DK seals (625 with a level, 439 legends of two or more signs): twelve closing-stock signs (740, 520, 090, 400, 151, 156, 527, 617, 621, 226, 892, 407) close 0.73, 0.75 and 0.72 of legends by third of height and 0.74 of the 61 legends below -18 ft; opening signs carry no height information (z 0.42, p 0.31); variant choice p 0.13, length p 0.11, overall inventory p 0.066; rectangular seals rise from 0.10 to 0.20 (p 0.002). Credence lowered from 0.35 to 0.20 before the freeze. Confirmation, Marshall seals (434 with a depth in 15 strata, 307 legends readable at both ends), one read 18 s after the hashed freeze: P1 pass (closing-stock share top minus bottom -0.006, 90% interval -0.105 to 0.096), P2 pass (bottom-third share 0.731), P3 pass (formula difference -0.057, interval -0.163 to 0.047); P4 fail (opening signs z 0.91, p 0.17), P5 fail (opening minus closing z -0.35, p 0.61), P6 fail (variants z 1.39, p 0.097), P7 fail (length r 0.018, p 0.38), P8 fail (DK-G sign heights r 0.055, p 0.16), P9 auxiliary fail (rectangular r -0.003, p 0.53). P4-P7 all failing meets the kill condition: C-0006 dead at 0.02. Area-only ranking gives the same outcomes; the two loader halves agree on the closing stock and disagree in sign on length, format and variants. Post-outcome (exploratory): Stouffer combination over both excavations p 0.17 openings, 0.14 length, 0.036 variants, with variant directions reversed between excavations in three classes.
challenge: The two excavators used different datums, so heights are comparable only within Mackay's DK area and within Marshall's sections; Marshall's bottom and top thirds lie under 4 ft apart at the median (6 ft and 2.3 ft below the surface) against 10.9 ft in DK-G, and the DK-G format rise did not repeat, so the confirmation sections may span little time. Residual and intrusive seals are not marked in either table. The deepest levels lie below the water table and are thinly sampled (82 DK-G seals below -18 ft). The bench loader splits at random by component, while the partition was by excavator. Variant population changed between two discovery runs after both values were seen.
remedy: Excavator split with the loader given the Marshall file alone and both halves read after the freeze, with a package ledger copied from bench/spent.json; within-stratum height ranks and stratified permutations; identical complete legends merged per stratum; equivalence intervals with single-deletion checks for the fixity predictions and ten-deletion permutation checks for drift passes; planted-effect power on Marshall-shaped synthetic populations with 25% and 50% height mixing for residual and intrusive finds; one scorer used for the Mackay rehearsal, the power simulation and the frozen read; Holm weighting of drift passes; dry run of the loader path on relabelled discovery rows. Independent recomputation of the population, P1/P2 shares and P4 with separate code after the read.
retry_when: Seals outside the Mackay 1938 and Marshall 1931 tables with levels published per trench (CISI 3.1, later Mohenjo-daro excavation reports), or a sequence with an independent clock and a positive control, such as HARP Periods 3A-3C within one Harappa mound, scored with the frozen P1-P5 statistics. Do not retest legend against level on the Mackay or Marshall populations, which are spent for stratigraphic_level.
